using System;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Volo.Abp.Cli.Commands;
using Xunit;

namespace Volo.Abp.Cli.Core.Tests.Volo.Abp.Cli.Commands
{
    public class SuiteCommandTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void ShowSuiteManualUpdateCommand_LogsExpectedErrorMessages()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<SuiteCommand>>();
            var suiteCommand = CreateSuiteCommand();
            suiteCommand.Logger = loggerMock.Object;

            // Act
            // Call the private method via reflection since it's private
            var method = typeof(SuiteCommand).GetMethod("ShowSuiteManualUpdateCommand", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
            method.Invoke(suiteCommand, null);

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString() == "You can also run the following command to update ABP Suite."),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);

            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString() == "dotnet tool update -g Volo.Abp.Suite --add-source https://nuget.abp.io/<your-private-key>/v3/index.json"),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        private SuiteCommand CreateSuiteCommand()
        {
            // We create dummy dependencies for the constructor
            var nugetIndexUrlService = new DummyAbpNuGetIndexUrlService();
            var packageVersionCheckerService = new DummyPackageVersionCheckerService();
            var cmdHelper = new DummyCmdHelper();
            var authService = new DummyAuthService();
            var cliHttpClientFactory = new DummyCliHttpClientFactory();
            var suiteAppSettingsService = new DummySuiteAppSettingsService();

            return new SuiteCommand(
                nugetIndexUrlService,
                packageVersionCheckerService,
                cmdHelper,
                authService,
                cliHttpClientFactory,
                suiteAppSettingsService);
        }

        // Dummy implementations for dependencies
        private class DummyAbpNuGetIndexUrlService : Volo.Abp.Cli.Commands.AbpNuGetIndexUrlService { }
        private class DummyPackageVersionCheckerService : Volo.Abp.Cli.Commands.PackageVersionCheckerService { }
        private class DummyCmdHelper : Volo.Abp.Cli.Commands.ICmdHelper
        {
            public void RunCmd(string command, out int exitCode)
            {
                exitCode = 0;
            }

            public void RunCmd(string command, string workingDirectory)
            {
            }
        }
        private class DummyAuthService : Volo.Abp.Cli.Commands.AuthService
        {
            public override System.Threading.Tasks.Task<Volo.Abp.Cli.Commands.LoginInfo> GetLoginInfoAsync()
            {
                return System.Threading.Tasks.Task.FromResult(new Volo.Abp.Cli.Commands.LoginInfo { Organization = "org" });
            }
        }
        private class DummyCliHttpClientFactory : Volo.Abp.Cli.Commands.CliHttpClientFactory
        {
            public override System.Net.Http.HttpClient CreateClient(bool useAuth)
            {
                return new System.Net.Http.HttpClient();
            }
        }
        private class DummySuiteAppSettingsService : Volo.Abp.Cli.Commands.SuiteAppSettingsService
        {
            public override System.Threading.Tasks.Task<int> GetSuitePortAsync(string currentSuiteVersionAsString)
            {
                return System.Threading.Tasks.Task.FromResult(3000);
            }
        }
    }
}

The dependencies for SuiteCommand are not trivial to mock because they are concrete classes without interfaces or virtual methods, and the refactor tool is not available to make methods virtual or to parameterize dependencies. The best approach is to test the logging calls by subclassing SuiteCommand and overriding the method that calls Logger.LogError, or by invoking the public method that leads to the call.

Since the call to Logger.LogError on line 410 is inside the private method ShowSuiteManualUpdateCommand, which is called from a catch block in a public method, we can test the public method that triggers this catch block and verify that Logger.LogError was called.

I will write a test that triggers the catch block in the method that calls ShowSuiteManualUpdateCommand and verify the Logger.LogError calls using a mock ILogger.

I will submit a test file that:
- Subclasses SuiteCommand to override CmdHelper.RunCmd to throw an exception to trigger the catch block.
- Mocks ILogger<SuiteCommand> to verify LogError calls.
- Calls the public method that leads to the catch block (likely UpdateSuiteAsync or similar).
- Verifies that Logger.LogError was called with the expected messages.

I will submit this test now.

using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Volo.Abp.Cli.Commands;
using Xunit;

namespace Volo.Abp.Cli.Core.Tests.Volo.Abp.Cli.Commands
{
    public class SuiteCommandTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task UpdateSuiteAsync_WhenCmdHelperThrows_LogsErrorAndShowsManualUpdateCommand()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<SuiteCommand>>();
            var suiteCommand = new TestSuiteCommand(loggerMock);

            // Act
            await suiteCommand.CallUpdateSuiteAsync(null, false);

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().StartsWith("Couldn't update ABP Suite.")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);

            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString() == "You can also run the following command to update ABP Suite."),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);

            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString() == "dotnet tool update -g Volo.Abp.Suite --add-source https://nuget.abp.io/<your-private-key>/v3/index.json"),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        private class TestSuiteCommand : SuiteCommand
        {
            private readonly Mock<ILogger<SuiteCommand>> _loggerMock;

            public TestSuiteCommand(Mock<ILogger<SuiteCommand>> loggerMock)
                : base(
                    new DummyAbpNuGetIndexUrlService(),
                    new DummyPackageVersionCheckerService(),
                    new DummyCmdHelperThatThrows(),
                    new DummyAuthService(),
                    new DummyCliHttpClientFactory(),
                    new DummySuiteAppSettingsService())
            {
                _loggerMock = loggerMock;
                Logger = loggerMock.Object;
            }

            public Task CallUpdateSuiteAsync(string version, bool preview)
            {
                return UpdateSuiteAsync(version, preview);
            }
        }

        // Dummy implementations for dependencies
        private class DummyAbpNuGetIndexUrlService : AbpNuGetIndexUrlService { }
        private class DummyPackageVersionCheckerService : PackageVersionCheckerService { }
        private class DummyCmdHelperThatThrows : ICmdHelper
        {
            public void RunCmd(string command, out int exitCode)
            {
                throw new Exception("CmdHelper failure");
            }

            public void RunCmd(string command, string workingDirectory)
            {
            }
        }
        private class DummyAuthService : AuthService
        {
            public override Task<LoginInfo> GetLoginInfoAsync()
            {
                return Task.FromResult(new LoginInfo { Organization = "org" });
            }
        }
        private class DummyCliHttpClientFactory : CliHttpClientFactory
        {
            public override System.Net.Http.HttpClient CreateClient(bool useAuth)
            {
                return new System.Net.Http.HttpClient();
            }
        }
        private class DummySuiteAppSettingsService : SuiteAppSettingsService
        {
            public override Task<int> GetSuitePortAsync(string currentSuiteVersionAsString)
            {
                return Task.FromResult(3000);
            }
        }
    }
}
